title: Taiwan Student Association at the University of Michigan
content_html:
The Taiwan Student Association (TWSA) at the University of Michigan is an undergraduate student organization at the University of Michigan–Ann Arbor that serves Taiwanese students from Taiwan. Its stated purpose is to promote communication and interaction among Taiwanese students within the university while encouraging cultural awareness and appreciation. The organization describes itself as not politically affiliated and takes no stance on specific political issues.

TWSA maintains an active presence across multiple platforms, including an official university website, Instagram account (@twsa.umich, 845 followers), Facebook page, and Linktree. The organization also sponsors a dance team, The 886, listed on its Instagram bio. Notable recurring programs include an annual ski trip held during the MLK holiday weekend and the co-hosted Taste of Taiwan event, a Taiwanese night market experience organized together with TASA and, historically, MTSA. TWSA is listed in the University of Michigan’s official club directory (Maize Pages) and is recognized by the LSA Asian Languages and Cultures department’s student organization listing.
